title: WGS Variant Calling
summary: Run a germline variant-calling workflow on real HG002 reads from a 1 Mb GRCh38 chromosome 17 region and produce a filtered VCF for evaluator-side benchmarking.
taskPrompt:
You are given paired-end HG002 sequencing reads covering a 1 Mb region of GRCh38 chromosome 17, plus the GRCh38 chromosome 17 reference.

Run an Ubuntu-native germline variant-calling workflow using `bwa`, `samtools`, and `bcftools`, then produce a filtered VCF containing SNP and INDEL calls.

Task directory:
- `base`

Input directory:
- `base/input`

Available environment:
- `bwa`, `samtools`, `bcftools`, FastQC, MultiQC, and RTG Tools are preinstalled on `PATH`

Required outputs under `base/output`:
- `region_R1_fastqc.html`
- `region_R2_fastqc.html`
- `multiqc_report.html`
- `flagstat.txt`
- `duplication_metrics.txt`
- `variants.filtered.vcf.gz`
- `variants.filtered.vcf.gz.tbi`
- `rtg_summary.csv` with the header `Type,Precision,Sensitivity,F_measure` and rows for SNP and INDEL; metric values may be `NA`

Do not ask for confirmation. Execute directly.
agentMustDo: Run an Ubuntu-native germline variant-calling workflow on real HG002 paired-end reads from the staged 1 Mb chr17 region.
Write outputs only under `output/` while keeping the staged input files untouched.
Work directly on Ubuntu; Windows + WSL is no longer the canonical runtime.

inputFiles.name: chr17.fa.fai
inputFiles.description: FASTA index for the chromosome 17 reference.

inputFiles.name: chr17.dict
inputFiles.description: Sequence dictionary for the chromosome 17 reference.

evaluation: Offline validation of the documented QC, VCF, index, and summary output contract.

classifier.rationale: The task involves running a germline variant-calling workflow in genomics.
